Acme's net balance of 5519 matches my own check: orders 250 and 253 total 20065, less the 14546 refund on order 250. Next I'll get birch's net balance.
Birch's net balance of 13637 matches my check: orders 251 and 254 total 15118, less the 1481 refund on order 251. Next I'll get cobalt's net balance.
Cobalt's balance of 53824 matches my check: orders 252 and 255 total 53824 with no refunds against them. Every balance agrees with the ledger, so I'll record the first payout, for acme.
Acme's payout of 5519 is recorded. Birch's net balance of 13637 already matched my own check, so I'll record that payout next.
Birch's payout of 13637 is recorded. Cobalt's balance of 53824 matched my own check (orders 252 and 255, no refunds), so I'll record that payout to finish the batch.
